verses.ar: وَصَعِدَ مُوسَى مِنْ عَرَبَاتِ مُوآبَ إِلَى جَبَلِ نَبُو، إِلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْفِسْجَةِ ٱلَّذِي قُبَالَةَ أَرِيحَا، فَأَرَاهُ ٱلرَّبُّ جَمِيعَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنْ جِلْعَادَ إِلَى دَانَ،
verses.kjv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that [is] over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
verses.web: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

verses.ar: وَجَمِيعَ نَفْتَالِي وَأَرْضَ أَفْرَايِمَ وَمَنَسَّى، وَجَمِيعَ أَرْضِ يَهُوذَا إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْغَرْبِيِّ،
verses.kjv: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
verses.web: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

verses.ar: وَٱلْجَنُوبَ وَٱلدَّائِرَةَ بُقْعَةَ أَرِيحَا مَدِينَةِ ٱلنَّخْلِ، إِلَى صُوغَرَ.
verses.kjv: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.web: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ: «هَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلَّتِي أَقْسَمْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ قَائِلًا: لِنَسْلِكَ أُعْطِيهَا. قَدْ أَرَيْتُكَ إِيَّاهَا بِعَيْنَيْكَ، وَلَكِنَّكَ إِلَى هُنَاكَ لَا تَعْبُرُ».
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, This [is] the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see [it] with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.web: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

verses.ar: فَمَاتَ هُنَاكَ مُوسَى عَبْدُ ٱلرَّبِّ فِي أَرْضِ مُوآبَ حَسَبَ قَوْلِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.web: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.

verses.ar: وَدَفَنَهُ فِي ٱلْجِوَاءِ فِي أَرْضِ مُوآبَ، مُقَابِلَ بَيْتِ فَغُورَ. وَلَمْ يَعْرِفْ إِنْسَانٌ قَبْرَهُ إِلَى هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.kjv: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.web: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ مُوسَى ٱبْنَ مِئَةٍ وَعِشْرِينَ سَنَةً حِينَ مَاتَ، وَلَمْ تَكِلَّ عَيْنُهُ وَلَا ذَهَبَتْ نَضَارَتُهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses [was] an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.web: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

verses.ar: فَبَكَى بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ مُوسَى فِي عَرَبَاتِ مُوآبَ ثَلَاثِينَ يَوْمًا. فَكَمُلَتْ أَيَّامُ بُكَاءِ مَنَاحَةِ مُوسَى.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping [and] mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.web: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

verses.ar: وَيَشُوعُ بْنُ نُونٍ كَانَ قَدِ ٱمْتَلَأَ رُوحَ حِكْمَةٍ، إِذْ وَضَعَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ يَدَيْهِ، فَسَمِعَ لَهُ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ وَعَمِلُوا كَمَا أَوْصَى ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَقُمْ بَعْدُ نَبِيٌّ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِثْلُ مُوسَى ٱلَّذِي عَرَفَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ وَجْهًا لِوَجْهٍ،
verses.kjv: ¶ And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.web: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

verses.ar: فِي جَمِيعِ ٱلْآيَاتِ وَٱلْعَجَائِبِ ٱلَّتِي أَرْسَلَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ لِيَعْمَلَهَا فِي أَرْضِ مِصْرَ بِفِرْعَوْنَ وَبِجَمِيعِ عَبِيدِهِ وَكُلِّ أَرْضِهِ،
verses.kjv: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.web: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

verses.ar: وَفِي كُلِّ ٱلْيَدِ ٱلشَّدِيدَةِ وَكُلِّ ٱلْمَخَاوِفِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ ٱلَّتِي صَنَعَهَا مُوسَى أَمَامَ أَعْيُنِ جَمِيعِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.web: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
